VAR MinMonthLY = CALCULATE ( MIN ( 'date'[month_of_date] ), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'date'[month_of_date] ), KEEPFILTERS ( 'date'[last_year_comparision_flag] = TRUE () ) )
VAR MaxMonthLY = CALCULATE ( MAX ( 'date'[month_of_date] ), SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( 'date'[month_of_date] ), KEEPFILTERS ( 'date'[last_year_comparision_flag] = TRUE () ) )
VAR LY = YEAR ( MinMonthLY )
VAR MinMonthCY = MIN ( attribution[month_of_attribution] )
VAR MaxMonthCY = MAX ( attribution[month_of_attribution])
VAR CY = YEAR ( MinMonthCY )
VAR MinMonthCY_Text = FORMAT ( MinMonthCY, "MMM" )
VAR MaxMonthCY_Text = FORMAT ( MaxMonthCY, "MMM" )
VAR MinMonthLY_Text = FORMAT ( MinMonthLY, "MMM" )
VAR MaxMonthLY_Text = FORMAT ( MaxMonthLY, "MMM" )
VAR diff = MONTH(MaxMonthCY) - MONTH(MinMonthCY) + 1
VAR SelectedMonths = COUNTROWS(VALUES(attribution[month_of_attribution]))
RETURN
IF( diff = 1,
"Data for " & MinMonthCY_Text & " (" & CY &
") is being compared with " & MinMonthLY_Text &
" (" & LY & ")",
IF(
diff = SelectedMonths,
"Data from " & MinMonthCY_Text & " to " & MaxMonthCY_Text & " (" & CY &
") is being compared with " & MinMonthLY_Text & " to " & MaxMonthLY_Text &
" (" & LY & ")",
"Data for " &
CONCATENATEX(VALUES(attribution[month_of_attribution]), FORMAT(attribution[month_of_attribution],"MMM"), ", ", attribution[month_of_attribution], ASC) &
" (" & CY & ") is being compared with " &
CONCATENATEX(VALUES(attribution[month_of_attribution]), FORMAT(attribution[month_of_attribution],"MMM"), ", ", attribution[month_of_attribution], ASC) &
" (" & LY & ")"
)
)
